title: If your tub has texture, Don't buy THIS!
text: If your tub has texture, Don't buy THIS!. If your tub is not slick smooth in texture, these suction cups dont work. My tub has a slight "texture" to it, possibly to help keep from slipping, but not as secure as a mat like this if it DID stick to the tub.

product_metadata.title: SlipX Solutions Power Grip Extra Long Bath Tub & Shower Mat 39x16, Wet Floor Non-Slip for Elderly & Kids Bathroom, 30% Longer Bathtub Mats, 200 Suction Cups, Drain Holes, Machine Wash, Trans Black
features: Powerful Grip: SlipX's power grip suction cups are almost 30% larger and are over 25% stronger & more pliable versus other brands, making it the best value bath mat available. Attach to any smooth, non-textured surface for better slip-resistance.
Comfortable Texture: Made of durable, high-quality soft to the touch vinyl with a unique textured surface pattern for reliable slip-resistant traction and extra comfort during baths or long showers.

Excellent Drainage & Machine Washable: Hundreds of drain holes throughout the safety mat reduce surface water by keeping water flowing during use and allowing for fast drying after use. Machine washable & easy to clean.
Oversized Coverage: Stretches the full length of your tub or shower, providing 30% more coverage than the average non-slip bath mat for added protection. Measures 39"L x 16"W.

Peace of Mind Promise: This product is backed by the SlipX Solutions Peace of Mind Promise. For any questions or concerns after using it, simply reach out to our friendly Customer Care Team via Amazon.
